subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should this fix preserve `ssrf-runtime-internal` as an owner-scoped private Browser/Ollama helper, or intentionally promote these two helpers to the public `ssrf-runtime` SDK contract?
rationale: Both paths can address the package-resolution bug, but choosing between private owner-scoped access and a new public SSRF/proxy helper contract is a maintainer-owned SDK/security-boundary decision.

options.title: Preserve Private Owner Scope
options.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through owner-scoped aliasing or staging, with package smoke proof.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Promotion
options.body: Promote the helpers only with explicit docs, contract tests, API metadata, release-note context, and security-boundary approval.

options.title: Pick A Canonical Sibling
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers choose a sibling PR or replacement branch as the canonical repair for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Private Owner Scope
recommendation.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through owner-scoped aliasing or staging, with package smoke proof.
